summary: spec.review of global-agent-skill-sync-v2 rev-0003 (all 5 selected domains covered; none inherited; no prior issues to re-evaluate). Canonical authority verified: rev-0003.json exists on disk, its sha256 matches the evidencePointer (0aea9697...), .change-state.json digest matches (38f61608...), and the embedded canonicalContract is consistent with the file. Requirements: intent/why/whatChanges are clear and mutually consistent; TASK-001..004 fully cover the stated change. Boundaries: user-level discovery (hub at ~/.agents/skills plus ~/.qoder-cn / ~/.codex / ~/.claude symlinks) vs project-level enforcement (install.sh hooks/policy) is coherently separated across intent, design, optionsConsidered (user-level hooks and per-product copies explicitly rejected), and AC-003; guard markers (.xian-commit/config / .xian-harness/) agree between design and AC-003; conflict preflight/all-or-nothing install and uninstall-only-own-links agree with AC-001/AC-002 and riskAndRollback; scope.changedPaths equals declaredScopePaths exactly (same 6 paths). Acceptance: AC-001..005 are well-formed, unambiguous, and symmetric with task acceptanceIds (checked bidirectionally); testable in principle. Verification: all 6 VCs are bounded read-safe commands; none recursively invokes this Change's guard/verify/Gate/lifecycle commands; VC-004 syntax-checking out-of-scope install.sh is a legitimate regression check for AC-003's 'project-level install unchanged'. Authority: contract reviewPolicy (read-only required, no agent pair, block-on-p1) is compatible with this review; tier forced to major via skill.contract is consistent with SKILL.md in declaredScopePaths; git base/head null and fileCount 0 are lifecycle metadata, not product gaps. No actionable defect in the current-phase snapshot; 6 info-level follow-ups recorded (non-discriminating blanket AC/VC coverage, unspecified SKILL.md-guard test assertion, empty requirement-level nonGoals/successSignals, unspecified ownership-marker placement, reviewer-runtime policy mismatch vs the stated Claude-reviewer restart, and lifecycle state lag). Accepted for the current phase only; Harness Gate remains the final delivery authority.

issues.title: Change state phase/nextAction lag the captured rev-0003 contract facts
issues.recommendation: Treat as lifecycle bookkeeping to be refreshed by the harness at the next phase transition; no product action required for this spec review.

issues.title: AC-003 SKILL.md guard lacks a specified dedicated content assertion
issues.recommendation: When detailing TASK-003 or the next contract revision, state explicitly that tests/test_sync_global.sh (or a content check) asserts the guard/degradation language in SKILL.md (e.g., presence of the .xian-commit/config / .xian-harness/ detection and the no-hook-claim wording), so AC-003 has dedicated evidence rather than only inheriting the general test entry.

issues.title: requirement.nonGoals and successSignals are empty; boundary exclusions live only in design
issues.recommendation: Consider materializing the key exclusions already stated in design (no user-level hooks; user-level sync never writes target-repo state; project-level install behavior unchanged) into requirement/scope nonGoals in a future revision for boundary clarity.

issues.title: Ownership marker .xian-global-managed placement and discovery rule unspecified
issues.recommendation: Specify in design where .xian-global-managed resides (e.g., a marker file inside the ~/.agents/skills hub) and how uninstall uses it to enumerate owned product-dir links, so uninstall semantics are unambiguous for implementation.

issues.title: Uniform AC-to-VC coverage mapping cannot discriminate evidence per acceptance criterion
issues.recommendation: In a future contract revision, consider narrowing each VC's covers list (e.g., AC-001/AC-002/AC-003 -> VC-001/VC-002 plus VC-003; AC-004 -> VC-005; AC-005 -> VC-006 as the meta-consistency check) so verify attempts map failures to the right acceptance criteria.

issues.title: Bundle reviewer policy pins codex-cli while the change rationale states a Claude-reviewer restart
issues.recommendation: Align the harness reviewer policy with the intended reviewer runtime for this change so the later build review does not stall on the same backend-access problem that caused the predecessor change to be abandoned. Configuration alignment note only; not a defect in this contract snapshot.
